actions.action: Top up exposed roots with soil without burying the trunk flare (quick-fix alternative)
Fully repot into well-draining mix (potting soil plus 30-50% perlite, pumice or bark)
Get a pot with drainage holes 1-2 inches wider than the current one
Gently loosen roots and trim any dead or mushy ones during repotting
Check soil and water when the top 1-2 inches are dry, letting excess drain
Place in bright light with some direct sun near a window
Feed with diluted fertilizer monthly in spring and summer
Watch for signs of overwatering (yellowing, mushy trunk base, sour smell)
